text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: high error rate for Shoreline (prod, VPC) websocket streams — observed 504/timeout spikes since 08:01 UTC. Auto-escalating to on-call.
alex_oncall: seeing it, joining. can someone dump the gateway logs for shore-prod-vpc?
maya_sre: pulling logs now. initial look: bursts of upstream 504s from customer appgw, coincident with >1k concurrent streams. TTLs expire during chunked transfer. logs: `appgw/shoreline-prod | upstream_response_time: 5123ms | status: 504` repeated.
liam_eng: timeline? did anything change at 08:00?
maya_sre: no deploys in our infra. shore deployment shows increased CPU on their appgw nodes per their metrics (they shared dashboards earlier).
alex_oncall: probable cause: customer app gateway's per-connection idle timeout + our keepalive mismatch causing mid-stream termination. also noticed client retries set aggressively, causing reconnect storm.
sofia_acct: pinged Shoreline infra lead (via DM). they confirm they're seeing a spike in backend GC pauses around that timeframe.
liam_eng: ok, immediate mitigation options: 1) instruct Shoreline to increase their appgw idle timeout to 90s, 2) enable our connection-level keepalive frames / extend proxy timeout, 3) temporarily route Shoreline traffic to the fallback dedicated pool in us-west-2 where we have capacity. which is quickest?
alex_oncall: fallback pool looks doable but needs a config route change and rate-limit bump. we can do that with a single rollout flag.
maya_sre: we can push a per-tenant routing override: `PATCH /v1/routing/overrides` body: `{"tenant":"shoreline","destination":"pool-us-west-fallback"}`. ops-runner-bot can apply if given ack.
ops-runner-bot: ready to run ops playbook. confirm: apply override + set proxy timeout to 120s for shoreline sessions.
liam_eng: while we prep that, recommend Shoreline temporarily disable client aggressive reconnect or add jitter. they can also switch streaming => short-poll for critical flows.
sofia_acct: Shoreline just confirmed they're applying GC tuning now and can flip to short-poll if needed. they asked if we can avoid a full cutover.
alex_oncall: let's try routing override + timeout bump first; that should absorb connection churn without customer action. maya, can you stage config and smoke test with a small percentage?
maya_sre: staging rollout: set 5% -> 25% -> 100%. smoke: initial 5% looks stable (no 504s). pushing to 25% now.
liam_eng: logging commands used for smoke: `curl -H "Connection: keep-alive" -N "https://api.redwood/proxy/shoreline/stream"` and watch chunk responses.
alex_oncall: 25% holding 2m, error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.8% for the routed sessions. good sign.
sofia_acct: Shoreline reports client retries reduced and websocket handshakes successful for routed traffic.
ops-runner-bot: applying 100% override and setting proxy timeout to 120s for tenant shoreline. will post when done.
ops-runner-bot: applied: override id 8f3b2a, proxy.timeout=120s. rollout complete.
maya_sre: monitoring cluster—post-change metrics: total 504s for Shoreline down 92% in 10m. connection churn normalized.
liam_eng: we should also add a short-term tenant rate-limit to smooth bursts: `tenant.rate_limit: 600 conn/min` for 1 hour.
alex_oncall: applying temp rate-limit window now.
ops-runner-bot: rate-limit applied for tenant=shoreline until 2026-03-17T10:00:00Z.
sofia_acct: Shoreline said they still saw a couple of client reconnects but overall user impact minimal; no degradation reported to end customers.
alex_oncall: escalation notes: this is a customer-induced backend GC + mismatch in keepalive semantics causing streaming timeouts. remediation: runbook actions executed (routing override, timeout bump, rate-limit). next: coordinate permanent mitigations with Shoreline.
liam_eng: follow-ups for postmortem: - ensure per-tenant default proxy timeout config is documented and surfaced in onboarding; - add guardrail to detect tenant-level reconnect storms and auto-shed to fallback; - add a prompt to Dedicated/VPC onboarding checklist about aligning appgw keepalive/idle timeouts.
maya_sre: creating incident ticket and linking metrics/dashboards. assign to oncall for follow-up: alex_oncall.
sofia_acct: I'll schedule a post-incident call with Shoreline for 10:30 UTC to coordinate GC tuning and permanent routing fallback options.
ops-runner-bot: incident severity set to Sev3. paging cleared. runbook: `/runbooks/streaming-timeouts` referenced in incident ticket.
alex_oncall: thanks team. if nothing else, I'll close incident in 30m once metrics stable. :thumbsup:
sofia_acct: thanks everyone — I’ll keep Shoreline looped in.
liam_eng: filing a short remediation PR to add tenant timeout param to Console UI.
maya_sre: noted. assigning to eng-runtime for longer-term auto-fallback work.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed by alex_oncall at 1773751899. Postmortem assigned: maya_sre, liam_eng, sofia_acct.
